abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this device is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found:
No BUSY Bar devices found.
Make sure to check the following:
- BUSY Bar is charged and powered on
- If you want to use Wi-Fi, go to SETTINGS > Wi-Fi and check whether BUSY Bar is connected to the same network than the machine running Home Assistant.
- If you want to use USB, check whether BUSY Bar is connected to the machine running Home Assistant.

notify.name: Show a notification
notify.description: Shows a message on the bar's front display, laid out to fit, with an optional icon and sound.

line_1.name: Line 1
line_1.description: The first, or only, line of text.

line_2.name: Line 2
line_2.description: A second line. Giving it uses the two-line layout.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: A built-in icon, drawn at the left edge.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: A built-in sound, played with the notification.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the notification stays on screen.

font.name: Font
font.description: Text font. The two largest only fit a single line.

background_color.name: Background colour
background_color.description: Fills the panel behind the text. Needs API 24.3.0.

start_timer.name: Start the timer
start_timer.description: Starts the session one of the bar's two cards describes. The kind of session and its lengths come from the card.

card.name: Card
card.description: Which of the bar's two cards to start.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Show this session in a different theme. The card keeps its own, which the bar returns to when the session ends.

stop_timer.name: Stop the timer
stop_timer.description: Ends the session, leaving nothing running. Not the same as the selector's off position, which is the bar's do-not-disturb.

pause_timer.name: Pause the timer
pause_timer.description: Pauses the running session where it is.

next_phase.name: Skip to the next phase
next_phase.description: Moves an interval session on: work becomes rest, rest becomes the next work. After the last interval the session ends.

set_theme.name: Set the theme
set_theme.description: Changes the theme. Without a card, the running session changes and reverts when it ends; with one, that card's own theme changes for good.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: A theme the bar has, such as meeting, dnd or lunch.

card.name: Card
card.description: Change this card's own theme instead of the running session's.

play_sound.name: Play a sound
play_sound.description: Plays one of the bar's built-in sounds.

clear.name: Clear the display
clear.description: Removes what this integration drew, leaving the bar's own screen. Notifications with a duration disappear on their own.
